sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 % [llm37535]
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer regarding pump housing ph-100. We appreciate you sharing the pressures your foundry faces, and we truly value our long, trustful cooperation and the dedication of your skilled team.

We note the requested increase of +8.8 %, but we cannot accept it. We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price. Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best. We commit to a binding volume of 4,000 pcs per year over 24 months. Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

We value our cooperation and look forward to continuing it on a fair basis.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We value our long-standing cooperation and appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract with 30-day payment terms, which allows us to offer €51.30.
Regarding the binding volume of 4,000 pieces per year you mentioned, please provide the concrete release schedule so we can verify this.
My colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
